author: Myv
body:
What is your age?

I am 15 years of age.

What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)

Myv#4294 (r8ys is my actual username.)

How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?

I am on most days. Whenever I am not on Avicus, I am on alexanderjoe's build server. Therefore, I make maps often although of course I like to take my time to complete maps because I want to ensure they are of high quality, gameplay and feel. I am on Minecraft and my PC for around 2 hours each day, however I can notify the correct people if I am away/cannot come on.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?

As well as my activeness, I am willing to try new ideas with maps and also push myself to make maps of gamemodes I may not have done before. However, although I want to take time in my maps, I can get a map done within a week and if I consistently kept this up, I can produce many maps for testing and to be potentially used on Avicus for players to enjoy. 

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?

I think a necessity to produce good gameplay maps is to introduce height variations for islands and especially high-trafficked areas which I believe I do effectively incorporating these into my maps anyway. Also, having enough room to PvP and bridge and making aesthetically pleasing maps with unusual block palettes and structures also improves gameplay and also appearance which is important to me when designing maps. Also, making maps regularly massively improves map building skills. I cannot stress enough how important this is from my perspective because making a lot of maps creates learning curves that help the individual for the future.

How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?

Being honest, I'm not. I have no experience with XML. This is why the fundamental reason for my Builder Application is to build maps, not program them. I am more than happy to build lots of maps, however I will need fellow Builders or Map Developers to take care of the XML and downloads for me when needed.

As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?

Building maps by miles. As I stated above, I am a novice with XML and have never tried using it, so building maps is far more enjoyable for me and something I would love to do regularly for Avicus.

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.
Iquora, a CTW map: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/a07e167b8
Sandbox, a 4TDM map: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/c23d3014a

Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.

Yes. I have made a total of 13 maps that have all been posted on the Avicus forums, including Frenzy, TDM, 4TDM, CTW, DTM and DTC. Therefore, I have a very wide range of map building and most of them have been rather good in my opinion, because I always strive to make them the best they can be based on constructive criticism aswell as my own personal needs. I have had no experience with XML but this is not my aim as a Builder, building maps is my goal and I have a lot of past experience in this.

Why do you want to be a builder?

I want to be a Builder because I am really passionate about making maps and it is an enjoyable pastime/ hobby for me when I play Minecraft. Yes, I rarely go on Avicus now, but this does not mean I am inactive. I can pretty much come on whenever I am called, unless I am at school or are out, which is rare. I want to make maps for Avicus for people to enjoy because without them, there would be no server.

How do you think you will help the map development team?

By building maps actively and effectively along with other people inside of and outside of the Development team, which is something I enjoy. Thank you for reading my application.

Congratulations. The Head Map Development Team has accepted you to embark on a journey to become a Builder. Please check discord for channel and expect your expectations as builder as well as the training documents. This will all be done by next Sunday so please be patient with us.

Thanks!
- The Head MapDevs
